enabled.description: Subchart toggle set by a parent chart's dependency condition.

global.description: Global values Helm passes to every subchart.

praxisConfig.description: Where praxis.yaml comes from: byo (you), operator (the Grid operator), or render (the chart).

source.description: Who writes praxis.yaml: byo (you), operator (the Grid operator), or render (the chart).

byo.description: Bring your own Praxis configuration, by ConfigMap or inline YAML.

configMapName.description: ConfigMap holding praxis.yaml; empty serves inline.

key.description: Key within configMapName that holds praxis.yaml.

inline.description: Praxis configuration stored in a chart-managed ConfigMap when configMapName is empty.

operator.description: Settings for the Grid operator's consumer ConfigMap.

allowUnauthenticatedExposure.description: Allow a LoadBalancer or NodePort Service although the operator's praxis.yaml has no caller authentication.

gridServing.description: Operator serving data used only with praxisConfig.source operator and a gridSiteRoute gatewayRef.

enabled.description: Mount the operator's serving config, set GRID_SERVING_CONFIG, and route with grid_site_route.

gatewayRefName.description: This gateway's name in GridNetwork gatewayRefs. Defaults to mountReconciliation.gatewayRef, then the release fullname.

mountPath.description: Directory the ConfigMap is mounted at.

render.description: Settings for praxisConfig.source render: secure-by-default rendered gateway config (praxis.yaml + policy.yaml). Never emits insecure_options.

telemetry.description: Optional exporter settings for generated praxis.yaml. Collector credentials must come from deployment-managed Secret environment references.

enabled.description: Enable OTLP export and the trace_context propagation filter.

otlpEndpoint.description: OTLP/gRPC endpoint without userinfo, query, or fragment credentials. Empty uses OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.

samplingRate.description: Root trace sampling probability from 0.0 through 1.0.

batchIntervalSecs.description: Positive batch exporter interval in seconds.

batchSize.description: Positive maximum spans per export batch.

role.description: consumer routes callers. provider serves grid peers with the grid identity.

mode.description: pin allows listed certificate digests. spiffe allows listed SPIFFE IDs.

certDigests.description: pin mode: lowercase hex SHA-256 of allowed peer leaf certificates.

spiffeIds.description: spiffe mode: allowed peer SPIFFE IDs.

digest.description: pin mode: the allowed peer's leaf digest, added to certDigests.

nextDigest.description: pin mode: a second leaf digest during rotation.

spiffeId.description: spiffe mode: an allowed peer SPIFFE ID, added to spiffeIds.

allowAnyGridSite.description: spiffe mode with no spiffeIds: accept any Grid-CA site.

allowedPaths.description: Exact paths forwarded to the local backend.

mode.description: Caller authentication, required for a render consumer. api-key needs an image that registers identity/api-key; provider role rejects it because providers authenticate peers by Grid identity.

allowUnauthenticatedExposure.description: With mode none, allow a LoadBalancer or NodePort Service.

stripAuthorization.description: Remove the caller's Authorization header before routing.

validateCA.description: CA for the validate call, set as SSL_CERT_FILE (replaces the platform trust store).

allowPrivateEndpoint.description: Sets allow_private_idp: every policy callout may reach private, loopback, and link-local addresses.

backends.description: Backends keyed by site, local for a provider's backend, or the older list of {cluster, endpoints}.

site.description: Grid site this backend serves. Required for a consumer's remote mutual_tls backend. Defaults to grid.siteName.

transport.description: Upstream transport. Remote-site backends default to mutual_tls with a Grid identity and CA. Without an identity, remote-site backends need an explicit transport mode. A provider local backend defaults to plaintext.

ca.description: tls only: CA bundle that verifies this backend.

site.description: Grid site this backend serves. Required for a consumer's remote mutual_tls backend. Defaults to grid.siteName.

transport.description: Upstream transport. Remote-site backends default to mutual_tls with a Grid identity and CA. Without an identity, remote-site backends need an explicit transport mode. A provider local backend defaults to plaintext.

ca.description: tls only: CA bundle that verifies this backend.

gridServing.description: Operator serving data used only with praxisConfig.source render.

enabled.description: Mount the operator's serving config, set GRID_SERVING_CONFIG, and route with grid_site_route.

gatewayRefName.description: This gateway's name in GridNetwork gatewayRefs. Defaults to the release fullname.

mountPath.description: Directory the ConfigMap is mounted at.

backendCAs.description: CA bundles for the operator's tls dials, mounted at /run/secrets/grid-backend-ca/<name>/<key>. Needs gridServing.enabled; not with mountReconciliation.

siteRoute.description: grid_site_route tuning, rendered into its filter block with the keys the filter reads.

capacity.description: Maximum prefix entries per backend cluster in each gateway replica; defaults to 16384.

ttl_secs.description: Prefix lifetime after a successful response, in seconds; defaults to 600.

listenerTls.description: Optional inbound TLS on the gateway listener. A non-empty secretName turns it on.

networkName.description: GridNetwork name used by the overlay sidecar.

upstreamCA.description: CA bundle for backend TLS without a per-cluster CA. Not used with operator source.

networkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicy limiting ingress to the listener port.

enabled.description: auto serves the listener for the grid-gateway image on OpenShift with networkPolicy.enabled and fills unset values from the platform. true needs each value set.
auto renders the ServiceMonitor when the listener is on, monitoring.coreos.com/v1 is served, and a CA is set.

labels.description: Additional labels on the ServiceMonitor, for a collector that selects by label.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

digest.description: Immutable image digest. When set, the tag is ignored.

flavor.description: ai is praxis-proxy/ai. grid-gateway is the grid build with the provider and praxisConfig.render.gridServing filters.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified app name.

podLabels.description: Additional labels on the gateway pod template.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations on the gateway pod template.

podSecurityContext.description: Extra pod-level securityContext fields. Protected fields (runAsNonRoot, seccompProfile) are chart-owned.

fsGroup.description: Filesystem group ID for volume mounts.

imageUser.description: Numeric runAsUser and runAsGroup for the Praxis container when podSecurityContext sets no runAsUser. A podSecurityContext runAsGroup replaces gid.

enabled.description: auto applies uid and gid to the official praxis-proxy ai, praxis, and grid-gateway images (not -fips tags), except when security.openshift.io/v1 is served. true applies them to any image.

command.description: Container command, replacing the image entrypoint. Empty keeps the entrypoint.

level.description: Level for every module: off, error, warn, info, debug, or trace, in any case. Empty leaves RUST_LOG unset, so the binary uses its own default (info).

filter.description: Full RUST_LOG directive, such as info,praxis_filter=debug. When set, it replaces level.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the Praxis container.

name.description: Port name. Empty: https when listenerTls.secretName is set, else http.

enabled.description: Create a Service for the gateway.

platform.description: Cloud whose load balancer settings LoadBalancer Services get: aws, azure, gcp, or any for all three, since each cloud reads only its own keys.

loadBalancerScope.description: Reach of the provider load balancer on a cloud platform: internal (private network) or external (internet-facing).

enabled.description: Render an OpenShift Route to the Service.

host.description: External hostname, a name on the gateway certificate.

externalTls.description: Attest that a BYO praxis.yaml serves TLS on the Service port with a certificate valid for route.host.

destinationCACertificate.description: PEM CA that signed the gateway certificate, for reencrypt.

configMapName.description: Name of the operator-produced overlay ConfigMap. A non-empty name enables overlay delivery; only for BYO source.

dataKey.description: ConfigMap data key containing the overlay envelope.

enabled.description: Annotate and delegate generated Secret mounts to the Grid operator.

network.description: GridNetwork name that opted into mount reconciliation.

gatewayRef.description: GridNetwork gatewayRefs name. Defaults to the Deployment name.

releaseHelmMounts.description: Release selected Helm-managed credentials and non-serving TLS mounts after the operator-owned configuration is ready.

managedCredentialNames.description: Credential Secret names whose mounts are owned by Grid; other credentials remain Helm-managed.

create.description: Create a Role and RoleBinding in the release namespace that let the operator ServiceAccount get and patch this chart's Deployment and no other.

serviceAccount.description: Operator ServiceAccount the Role binds. Empty fails the render while rbac.create is true.

namespace.description: Namespace of the operator ServiceAccount. Empty fails the render while rbac.create is true.

gridIdentity.description: Grid identity Secret with tls.crt and tls.key. The CA may be in a separate Secret.

tlsSecretName.description: Secret holding the client certificate and key.

caSecretName.description: Secret holding ca.crt. Empty uses tlsSecretName.

mountPath.description: Mount path for the credential Secret. Defaults to /run/secrets/grid-credentials/<sanitized-secretName>.

readiness.description: Readiness probe settings. Null to disable.

liveness.description: Liveness probe settings. Null to disable.

adminProbeCommand.description: Command for the admin-listener probe, with the URL appended. Empty uses /bin/sh with curl or wget.

shutdownDelaySeconds.description: Seconds a terminating pod keeps serving before Praxis gets SIGTERM, as a preStop sleep. 0 disables it, which an image without a sleep binary needs.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds Kubernetes gives a terminating pod before killing it. Null: 30 plus shutdownDelaySeconds.

priorityClassName.description: Priority class for the gateway pod.
